en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European street with a large, ornate three‑story school building labeled as a 'Realgymnasium' on the left side and smaller townhouses and shops along the cobblestone street. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the road. Printed red text at the top identifies the town and school, and a red handwritten number appears at the upper right.
